sources.title: NASA SmallSat State of the Art: Guidance, Navigation, and Control
sources.scope_note: Chapter 5.0, updated 2026-05-07. Use the registered section-level passage locators; technical descriptions do not prove spacecraft-specific fault occurrences.

sources.title: NESC GN&C Robust and Reliable Space Vehicle Best Practices
sources.scope_note: NASA/TP-20230005922, including GN&C Best Practice #5 (printed page 68); supports fault-management independence methodology, not case-level fault labels.

sources.title: Basilisk spacecraft simulation official documentation
sources.scope_note: Official documentation landing page. Pin the installed Basilisk release and exact versioned module page before making API or model-behavior claims.

sources.title: User-supplied AAS 56-channel telemetry catalog (2026-10-20)
sources.scope_note: Public repository stores no source CSV or raw telemetry; channel names and units in this repo are selected metadata, not observed samples.

sources.title: User-supplied AAS fault type catalog (2026-10-20)
sources.scope_note: Fault identity and sample group metadata are not admissible prediction inputs.

sources.title: User-supplied AAS 19-run observability summary (2026-10-23)
sources.scope_note: Direct observation channel count in catalog does not prove per-run observability or observed fault severity.

sources.title: SatAgentSimulation Basilisk ADCS unified capability manifest
sources.scope_note: Declared/candidate capability or effect is not a verified fault-injection run.

sources.title: AstroGraph-LLM knowledge schema v3
sources.scope_note: Contains structural definitions and human-review states, not validated physical relationships.

sources.title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions (ACL 2023)
sources.scope_note: Methodology only; cannot validate aerospace facts.

sources.title: 面向多源异构数据的航天器故障知识图谱构建方法 (2023)
sources.scope_note: Title only, no copyrighted PDF or text copied to this repository.

sources.title: ESA benchmark for anomaly detection in satellite telemetry (Scientific Data)
sources.scope_note: Anomaly labels must not be converted into component-level root-cause labels.

sources.title: 卫星科普：卫星姿态控制
sources.scope_note: Chinese-language official educational description of attitude frames and the sensor-controller-actuator loop; not a normative terminology standard or a fault-specific diagnosis source.

sources.title: Basilisk Version 2.11.0 Release Notes
sources.scope_note: Release-specific compatibility and packaging record. It does not by itself establish a fault model, physical effect, or telemetry truth.

sources.title: NEOSSat: Operational and Scientific Evolution of Canada’s Resilient Space Telescope
sources.scope_note: Public operational history describing magnetometer, torque-rod controller and X reaction-wheel anomalies. Preserve explicit uncertainty: the 2021 X-wheel cause was suspected electrical, not confirmed.

sources.title: Fault modeling of general momentum exchange devices in spacecraft attitude control systems
sources.scope_note: Models reaction wheels and single-gimbal CMGs as motor/variable-speed-drive cascades. Model-specific additive/multiplicative fault results must not be generalized beyond stated assumptions.

sources.title: Fault detection and diagnosis in a spacecraft attitude determination system
sources.scope_note: Uses rate gyros and vector sensors with Kalman filtering and gyro-bias estimation; additive sensor-fault formulation is a model assumption, not a universal physical failure law.

sources.title: Advanced fault detection and diagnosis in spacecraft attitude control systems: Current state and challenges
sources.scope_note: Review of spacecraft attitude-control FDD methods and practical gaps including residual sensitivity, model fidelity, noise, tuning and robustness.

sources.title: Space weather radiation effects on geostationary satellite solid-state power amplifiers
sources.scope_note: Analyzes 26 Inmarsat SSPA anomalies from 1996–2012. SSPA current is used for anomaly detection; the paper says the individual causes were not identified or confirmed. It describes SSPA as EPC plus FETs and classifies operator-observed hard/soft anomalies.

sources.title: ECSS-E-HB-20-05A Space engineering: High voltage engineering and design handbook
sources.scope_note: ECSS/ESA handbook; §4.4.2 describes TWTA EPC outputs and functional blocks, while §§4.3.3–4.3.5 cover partial discharge, Paschen breakdown and ageing. Design guidance is not proof of a specific in-orbit failure.

sources.title: Transmitter microdischarges in communications and broadcast Satellites
sources.scope_note: Describes high-voltage microdischarges, EPC autonomous restart and the anode-voltage '20 min Effect'. A protection/restart event is not automatically a permanent EPC hardware failure.

sources.title: In-Orbit Reliability Evaluation of Space TWTA Based on Copula Function and Bivariate Hybrid Stochastic Processes
sources.scope_note: Describes TWTA as TWT plus EPC; insufficient cathode emission and vacuum degradation are identified as TWT failure causes. Helix current and anode voltage are joint performance indicators and do not uniquely identify EPC failure.

sources.title: Lessons learned from systems engineering on the James Webb Space Telescope
sources.scope_note: Table 2 reports a TWTA-1 unexpected power-off during pre-thermal-vacuum functional testing; manufacturer attributed it to a parts failure in the TWTA electrical power conditioner. The specific failed part/mechanism is not disclosed.
